name: slim-sheet
description: Universal, token-frugal spreadsheet MCP server and CLI for any agent, from local 7B models to frontier models.
long_description: Reads xlsx, xls, xlsb, ods, Numbers, csv, parquet and json locally. Token-budgeted output, SQL over sheets, cleaning, anomaly detection, a formula copilot and Excel-correct editing. Edits go to a .slim copy unless you allow overwriting, and every change can be undone.

tools.name: overview
tools.description: Map a spreadsheet file: sheets, used ranges, header row, column names and types. Call this first. Example: overview(path='sales.xlsx')

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read cells as a table with A1 coordinates. Optional sheet, range like 'A1:F50', cursor from a previous read, format markdown|tsv|json.

tools.name: find
tools.description: Find cells containing text (or a regex) across sheets; returns Sheet!A1 addresses. Example: find(path='sales.xlsx', text='refund')

tools.name: query
tools.description: Run one read-only SQL SELECT; tables are sheet names, quote names with spaces. Example: sql='SELECT "Region", sum("Total") FROM "Orders" GROUP BY 1'

tools.name: profile
tools.description: Column statistics for a sheet: type, nulls, distinct, min, max, mean, median, top values. Optional columns list.

tools.name: write
tools.description: Write a 2-D values array starting at range's top-left cell, e.g. values=[['Total', 120]]. Saves to <name>.slim.xlsx unless overwrite=true.

tools.name: explain_formula
tools.description: Explain and check an Excel formula: steps, references, syntax/arity errors. Pass formula='=...' or path plus cell like 'Sheet1!C7'.

tools.name: clean
tools.description: Clean a table: ops from trim, collapse_spaces, remove_nonprintable, unify_null, numbers_from_text, normalize_dates, drop_empty_rows, drop_empty_cols, dedupe. Previews unless apply=true.

tools.name: anomalies
tools.description: Find suspicious cells: duplicate keys, wrong types, outliers, spelling variants, bad dates, stray spaces. Returns Sheet!A1 addresses.

tools.name: merge
tools.description: Join two tables on keys (how=left|inner|full|anti) and count unmatched rows on both sides. keys=['ID'] or ['ID=Order No']. out_path saves the result.

tools.name: convert
tools.description: Convert a file to xlsx, csv, tsv, parquet or json (by out_path extension). Reads xls, xlsb, ods, csv and more.

tools.name: diff
tools.description: Compare two files cell by cell, or row by row with key='ID'. Example: diff(path='a.xlsx', other_path='a.slim.xlsx')

tools.name: undo
tools.description: Undo the last slim-sheet write to a file (write, clean, convert or merge output).

tools.name: validate_formula
tools.description: Check a formula before writing it: syntax, unknown functions, Excel version (target='2016' or 'xls'), missing sheets/names. Gives fixes.

tools.name: evaluate
tools.description: Calculate a formula offline, alone or against a workbook. Example: evaluate(path='x.xlsx', cell='Calc!C7') or evaluate(formula='=ROUND(2.5,0)')

tools.name: describe_cell
tools.description: Everything about one cell: value, formula, number format, font, fill, comment, validation, merge. Example: describe_cell(path='x.xlsx', cell='Sheet1!B2')

tools.name: create_workbook
tools.description: Create a new empty .xlsx with the given sheet names. Example: create_workbook(path='out.xlsx', sheets=['Data','Summary'])

tools.name: sheet_ops
tools.description: Add, rename, delete, copy, move, hide or unhide a sheet (op=...). Renames also fix formulas that point to the sheet.

tools.name: rows_ops
tools.description: Insert or delete rows/columns (op=insert_rows|delete_rows|insert_cols|delete_cols, at='5' or 'C', count). Formulas, merges, names are shifted like Excel.

tools.name: name_ops
tools.description: List, add or delete defined names. Example: name_ops(path, op='add', name='TaxRate', ref='Rates!B2')

tools.name: format_range
tools.description: Style a range: bold, italic, font_color, fill_color ('yellow' or '#FFEB9C'), number_format ('currency', 'percent', 'date' or custom), align, wrap, border, autofit.

tools.name: set_table
tools.description: Turn a range with a header row into a named Excel table. Example: set_table(path, sheet='Data', range='A1:D50', name='Sales')

tools.name: add_validation
tools.description: Add a dropdown or rule: type=list (values=[...]), whole, decimal, date, text_length (min/max) or custom (formula).

tools.name: conditional_format
tools.description: Highlight cells by rule: greater_than, less_than, between, equal, text_contains, duplicates, top_n, color_scale, data_bar, formula.

tools.name: add_chart
tools.description: Insert a chart (column, bar, line, pie, area, scatter) from data_range: header row + category column + series columns.

tools.name: pivot
tools.description: Summarise a table: rows=['Region'], values=['Total'], agg=sum|count|avg|min|max, optional columns='Month'. Save with out_path or to_sheet.

tools.name: split
tools.description: Split a table by a column's values into sheets of one workbook (mode=sheets) or separate files (mode=files).

tools.name: recalc
tools.description: Recalculate every formula with LibreOffice so cached values are fresh (needs LibreOffice installed).

data_folder.title: Data folder
data_folder.description: Folder with the spreadsheets slim-sheet may read and write
